text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the forest on this property was observed to have had tree-cover loss in 2021. The loss area was 81.3 hectares, which is about 2.23% of the asset. However, there is no evidence of ongoing clearing today. The most recent data available is from 2025, and no further loss events were reported after 2021. Additionally, there were smaller patches of loss in 2021 that were not counted as events, totaling 37.3 hectares. Therefore, while there was past deforestation, there is no indication of current clearing activities.
